recent_excerpts: CVE-2026-60004, a 9.8-CVSS Gitea RCE, is under active attack per CISA. Attackers with repo write access can run shell commands. Patch now.
At Black Hat USA 2026, officials and researchers warn AI-driven vulnerability discovery outpaces defenses.
CISA gives federal agencies until Aug 25 to patch CVE-2026-68820, a Winsock privilege-escalation flaw exploited by North Korea's Lazarus in Operation Dream Job.
